name: Pioglitazone
description: A peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma agonist approved for type 2 diabetes. Carries a boxed warning for congestive heart failure.

systems.note: Insulin sensitisation through PPAR-gamma agonism; the labelled indication.
Boxed warning for congestive heart failure driven by fluid retention.
Transaminase elevation is labelled; the withdrawn class predecessor was withdrawn for hepatic failure.
Weight gain, oedema and bone fracture risk are labelled.

monitors.why: Labelled transaminase monitoring; a class with a hepatic history.
Labelled weight gain is adipose redistribution, not lean accrual.
